reasoning_details.text:
**Analyzing Spring XD/Framework Tasks**

I'm currently focused on evaluating user stories for Spring XD and Spring Framework. My initial thoughts are centered around understanding the scope of a request to add an `info` command to an `xd-yarn` script for Zookeeper queries. I'll then move on to assessing support for Reactor.

**Investigating XD Plugin Extensions**

My current focus is on developing a plugin for stream processors, similar to Spark or RxJava, and implementing message header history tracking. I'm also exploring adding Google Protocol Buffers for serialization and ensuring robust support for partitioned jobs with advanced table-column logic in the `JdbcHdfsOptionsMetadata`.

**Developing Plugin and Codec**

I'm currently prioritizing the implementation of message header history tracking and the Protocol Buffer codec. Next, I'll focus on developing the Ambari plugin and creating a performance test suite for complex object payloads.

**Refining XD Plugin Logic**

I'm now refining the partitioning option metadata validation within `JdbcHdfsOptionsMetadata` and ensuring comprehensive test coverage for various `sql` and `tableName` combinations. I'll also update the project wiki with these details.

**Planning Development Tasks**

I'm currently breaking down development activities, estimating effort for each, and ensuring our build tools and test infrastructure are ready. My focus is on completing the `xd-yarn info` command and the Reactor Stream Processor Plugin.

technical_and_design_decisions: The xd-yarn CLI command will leverage Apache Curator / ZooKeeper client API to query active Spring XD container and admin server runtime metadata from ZooKeeper paths.

The Reactor stream processor module plugin will build upon Project Reactor and integrate with Spring XD module registration mechanics, allowing minimal class configuration via module option definitions.
Message header history tracking will be implemented using a custom ChannelInterceptor or Header Enricher component in Spring XD's messaging pipeline to prepend stream and module traversal metadata.
Protobuf codec support will implement Spring XD Codec interface using Google Protocol Buffer Java library (v3 API) for high-performance serialization/deserialization.
The Ambari plugin will follow standard Apache Ambari stack definition conventions, using Python lifecycle management scripts for configuring, starting, stopping, and monitoring Spring XD nodes.
JdbcHdfsOptionsMetadata validation logic for mutually exclusive 'tableName' vs 'sql' parameters will be refined and validated via standard Bean Validation (@AssertTrue) annotations.
assumptions: The developer has access to existing Spring XD source repositories, build environments, and test clusters running Hadoop/YARN and Apache Ambari.
A running ZooKeeper instance and target Spring XD deployment are available for local and integration testing.
Documentation work refers to updating existing Spring XD wiki pages or markdown documentation files in the repository.
No major baseline architectural changes to Spring XD core are required beyond the user stories listed.

activities.activity_description: Analyze requirements across all user stories (U1-U8), define interface contracts, refine component interactions for Reactor plugins, Protobuf codec, Ambari integration, and plan overall test strategy.
Extend xd-yarn script and underlying Java CLI commands to query ZooKeeper for runtime state, host, and dynamic admin server port info, formatting output for CLI user display.

activities.activity_name: Implement Reactor Stream Processor Plugin Support (U2)
activities.activity_description: Develop the plugin architecture enabling Reactor-based stream processors, simplified class specification minimal configuration, and module option command binding.
Implement message header enrichment to track and log execution history (stream name, module name, sequence) across message processing pipelines.
Create Protobuf codec implementation adhering to Spring XD codec standards for native object serialization/deserialization.

activities.activity_name: Develop Complex Object Test Suite & Performance Benchmarks (U5)
activities.activity_description: Create automated performance and verification tests covering complex objects, Protobuf structures, deep object trees, and generate baseline performance metrics documentation.

activities.activity_name: Develop Ambari Management Plugin for Spring XD (U6)
activities.activity_description: Create Apache Ambari stack definitions, metrics configuration, and Python lifecycle scripts to enable provisioning, managing, and monitoring Spring XD cluster nodes.

activities.activity_name: Update Partitioning Options Logic and Wiki Documentation (U7, U8)
activities.activity_description: Update and test JdbcHdfsOptionsMetadata bean validation logic for 'sql' vs 'tableName'/'columns' exclusivity, write unit tests for partitioned jobs, and update relevant wiki documentation.
Perform end-to-end testing across all user stories including CLI commands on YARN, message history propagation, Protobuf streams, and Ambari management stack.
